name.value: Sprouted Oven by Silver Hills Bakery

description.value: Sprouted Oven is a 100% plant-based, non-GMO bakery, kitchen, and grocery space offering everything from sourdough and custom cakes to pizzas, burgers, lattes, and smoothies under one roof. The bakery maintains a dedicated enclosed gluten-free area with its own ovens, utensils, and air-pressure system — a rare setup that makes it genuinely accessible to celiac cyclists. It's a full-service food stop for riders with dietary restrictions who would otherwise struggle to find satisfying plant-based options along this corridor.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack (3 spaces) at 64m; rack (7 spaces) at 85m. Total: 10 spaces.
